messages:
From: Alex Torres <atorres@brightstat.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, sam.kelley@brightstat.com
Date: 2027-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP & evaluation plan template?

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost breakdowns were helpful. We have a small internal committee at BrightStat looking to run a 30–45 day evaluation to validate model behavior on our support dataset.

Can you share a MAP (mutual action plan) template you typically use for pilots? We want something we can drop into our procurement and engineering calendars that includes:
- clear success criteria (latency targets, token cost ceiling, accuracy checks)
- owner assignments for tech validation and procurement
- risk/mitigation and roll-back triggers
- a proposed timeline to close if evaluation meets criteria

If you have a 30/45/60-day set of examples that would be ideal. Also looking for a short Week-0 checklist for access/keys/networking.

Thanks — cc'ing Sam Kelley (VP Ops) who will help set up the workshop.

Best,
Alex
Alex Torres
Director of Engineering | BrightStat
atorres@brightstat.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan template?

Alex — thanks for the detailed ask and for looping Sam in. I've attached a working MAP template (Google Doc) and a concise Week-0 checklist PDF to get you past access and infra gating points. High level suggestions below; I put owners in brackets for who we recommend on our side.

Proposed pilot cadence (flexible):
- Week 0 (prep): access, network allowlist, schema & sample data handoff [Dev Patel]
- Week 1–2 (integration): deploy test harness, run baseline prompts, measure latency/throughput [Dev Patel + BrightStat eng]
- Week 3 (quality & regression): evaluate answer quality on curated prompt set; capture logs & deltas [Marissa Cole]
- Week 4 (soak & economics): longer-run hit tests, cost-per-1k analysis, autoscaling validation [Jasmine Liu + Dev Patel]
- Close window: decision meeting; if metrics meet acceptance criteria, proceed to a dedicated capacity proposal and SOW.

Suggested acceptance criteria (example):
- 95th percentile latency <= 350ms for 1k token bursts
- Inference cost <= $0.75 per 1k tokens at expected QPS
- No more than 2% regression in labeled accuracy vs baseline on our test set
- KV/prefix caching validated for repeated session flows

Seed workshop idea: 60–90 minute session where we map owners, hand off test prompts, and confirm Week-0 tasks. How does Aug 10 or Aug 11 look for your team?

Links & attachments:
- MAP template (working copy): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-redwood-MAP-template
- Attachment: redwood_MAP_template_v1.gdoc (working draft)
- Attachment: MAP-week0-checklist.pdf

If you want, we can pre-seed the doc with BrightStat owners based on your org chart. Next step: confirm workshop date and who from your side will own procurement follow-ups.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Jasmine — this is great, thank you. A few quick notes from our side after an internal review:
- We care more about median and P95 for our conversational experience than 1k-burst numbers; could you add median and P95 targets to the acceptance criteria?
- Cost target: looking for guidance that keeps inference spend predictable — can your team model cost at our expected QPS (I can share numbers offline)?
- Procurement: please include a short list of the minimal terms we should expect in a pilot SOW (data handling, retention, SLA tiers).

Aug 10 looks good for the seed workshop for our folks. Can we lock a 9:00–10:30 PT slot? I'll confirm two engineers + our security ops lead.

Also tagging a couple of lines from your note below to keep in the thread:

> Suggested acceptance criteria (example):

Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround. I reviewed the MAP and made a few edits (metrics section and a short regression test plan). I also added an explicit "stop-gap" trigger: if at any point P95 latency exceeds 600ms under expected QPS for more than 30 minutes, we pause the test and escalate.

I've attached a reviewed copy: MAP-v1-reviewed.gdoc. A couple of asks for you before the workshop:
- Please share the expected QPS and a 2–3 page snippet of the support dataset (anonymized) so Dev can pre-populate the harness.
- Who will be your procurement contact? We'll prepare a pilot SOW template to speed approvals.

Next steps: Jasmine will send calendar invite + pre-seeded MAP with BrightStat owners by EOD tomorrow. Dev will start a network checklist and confirm allowlist IPs once we have sample QPS.

Thanks — looking forward to Aug 10.
